title: fjbukhari/afla
description: Germline small-variant analysis of Illumina panels and exomes: read QC, alignment, coverage, variant calling (GATK or DeepVariant), Ensembl VEP annotation and an interactive teaching report. Education and research use only, not for clinical use.

input.title: Input
input.description: Give ONE input. This also decides where the workflow starts: FASTQ = full analysis, BAM/CRAM = skip alignment, VCF = annotation and report only.

fastq.title: FASTQ folder
fastq.description: Folder with paired Illumina FASTQ files (*_R1_001 / *_R2_001, or *_1 / *_2; .fastq, .fq, .fastq.gz or .fq.gz). Sub-folders are searched too.
fastq.help_text: Each sample needs an R1 and an R2 file. Several lanes of the same sample (_L001, _L002, ...) are joined automatically. If the same reads exist both compressed and uncompressed, the .gz copy is used once. Files are read where they are; nothing is copied.

bam.title: BAM / CRAM (file or folder)
bam.help_text: The BAM/CRAM must be aligned to the same reference you choose below.

vcf.title: VCF file
vcf.description: Existing variant file (GRCh38, from any pipeline). Only annotation and the report are run.

sample_name.title: Sample name (optional)
sample_name.description: Overrides the name taken from the file names. With a FASTQ folder, ALL files are then treated as one sample.

ref.title: Reference genome (FASTA)
ref.description: GRCh38 FASTA, uncompressed (recommended: hg38 / GRCh38 no-alt analysis set). Not needed when starting from a VCF. Choose the data file itself (if you pick its .fai/.tbi index by mistake, the workflow uses the file next to it).
ref.help_text: bwa index files (.amb .ann .bwt .pac .sa) should sit next to it. The .fai and .dict files are made automatically if missing.

build_bwa_index.title: Build bwa index if missing
build_bwa_index.description: Builds the aligner index for the reference (about 1 hour and ~5 GB, needed once). It is saved in the output folder under reference/; copy it next to the FASTA to reuse it.

bed.title: Target regions (BED, optional)
bed.description: Capture kit or panel regions (e.g. Twist Exome 2.0, IDT xGen, Agilent SureSelect; hg38). If empty, the regions the reads actually cover are used.
bed.help_text: Chromosome names with or without 'chr' are both accepted. Regions are padded (below) and overlapping regions merged.

bed_padding.title: Padding around targets (bp)
bed_padding.description: Extra bases added on each side of every target region, to include nearby splice sites.

auto_targets_min_depth.title: Minimum depth for automatic targets
auto_targets_min_depth.description: Only used without a BED file: positions with at least this many reads are treated as targets.

steps.title: Steps to run
steps.description: Tick or untick steps. Steps that do not apply to your input (e.g. trimming when starting from BAM) are skipped automatically.

run_fastp.title: 1. Read QC and trimming (fastp)
run_fastp.description: Removes adapters and low-quality ends and writes a read-quality report.

mark_duplicates.title: 2. Mark duplicate reads
mark_duplicates.description: Keep ON for exomes and hybrid-capture panels. Turn OFF for amplicon panels, where every read of an amplicon starts at the same place by design.

run_coverage.title: 3. Coverage QC (mosdepth)
run_coverage.description: Mean depth and % of target bases at 10x/20x/30x/50x/100x; lists poorly covered regions.

run_calling.title: 4. Variant calling
run_calling.description: Turn off to stop after alignment and coverage.

caller.title: Variant caller
caller.description: gatk = GATK HaplotypeCaller (CPU, container already on this laptop). deepvariant = Google DeepVariant (uses the GPU; first use downloads a large container).
caller.help_text: Both are germline callers: they expect variants at ~50% or ~100% of reads. They are not suitable for low-frequency somatic variants.

deepvariant_model.title: DeepVariant model
deepvariant_model.description: WES for exomes and capture panels, WGS for whole genomes.

use_gpu.title: Use the NVIDIA GPU (DeepVariant)
use_gpu.description: Uses the GPU version of DeepVariant. Turn off if no NVIDIA GPU is available.

run_annotation.title: 5. Annotate variants (Ensembl VEP)
run_annotation.description: Adds gene, consequence, HGVS, gnomAD frequency, ClinVar, REVEL and AlphaMissense (sources set below).

run_report.title: 6. Interactive report
run_report.description: One HTML report with QC, coverage and a filterable variant table (opens in the Report tab).

variant_filter.title: Variant quality filter
variant_filter.description: Calls failing these are kept in the VCF but labelled LowQual (the report hides them by default).

annotation.title: Annotation sources
annotation.description: Local files, so annotation works offline. Leave optional sources empty to skip them.

vep_cache.title: VEP cache folder
vep_cache.description: Folder that contains homo_sapiens/<version>_GRCh38 (the offline Ensembl cache; includes gnomAD v4.1 frequencies).

vep_cache_version.title: VEP cache version
vep_cache_version.description: Must match the cache folder and the VEP container (115).

vep_fasta.title: Ensembl FASTA for HGVS names (optional)
vep_fasta.description: Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.dna.primary_assembly.fa (with .fai). Needed for c./p. (HGVS) notation. Choose the data file itself (if you pick its .fai/.tbi index by mistake, the workflow uses the file next to it).

vep_plugins_dir.title: VEP plugins folder (optional)
vep_plugins_dir.description: Folder with REVEL.pm / AlphaMissense.pm. Default: the Plugins folder inside the VEP cache folder.

clinvar_vcf.title: ClinVar VCF (optional)
clinvar_vcf.description: clinvar_GRCh38.vcf.gz with its .tbi index (monthly releases from NCBI). Choose the data file itself (if you pick its .fai/.tbi index by mistake, the workflow uses the file next to it).

revel_file.title: REVEL scores (optional)
revel_file.description: new_tabbed_revel_grch38.tsv.gz with .tbi. Missense pathogenicity score (0-1). Choose the data file itself (if you pick its .fai/.tbi index by mistake, the workflow uses the file next to it).

alphamissense_file.title: AlphaMissense scores (optional)
alphamissense_file.description: AlphaMissense_hg38.tsv.gz with .tbi (free for non-commercial use). Choose the data file itself (if you pick its .fai/.tbi index by mistake, the workflow uses the file next to it).

output_format.title: Alignment file format
output_format.description: CRAM is about half the size of BAM (needs the reference to open, e.g. in IGV).

report_max_pop_af.title: Report: default maximum population frequency
report_max_pop_af.description: Starting value of the 'rare variant' filter in the report (adjustable there).

report_min_vaf.title: Report: default minimum VAF
report_min_vaf.description: Starting value of the minimum variant allele fraction filter in the report. Germline heterozygous variants sit near 0.5; lower values are often artefacts or somatic/mosaic changes (adjustable in the report).

threads.title: CPU threads
threads.description: Maximum CPU threads for the heavy steps (alignment, calling, annotation).

resources.run_time: Panel: 15-30 minutes. Exome: about 2-4 hours (GATK) or less with DeepVariant on the GPU.
